text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship and I successfully make it back
to school. The next day, I
attend her
race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Students chatter amongst themselves while
waiting for the races to
kick off.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're here at the track, and I'm Golshi,
reporting live from the race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've got a fledgling trainer here for an
exclusive interview. ☆ Tell me,
are you
excited to be here today?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, way to break the immersion. How
many times do I have to drill
it into you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I need you more than ever today, so time
to step up. Feel me? A racer
has to have a
trainer to enter the Twinkle Series, see?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I managed to fake my way through the
application process without
one, but
there's no way that would fly at the actual
race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: 'Scuse me? ...You still have no idea why I chose you specifically?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look, you've been watching us training
from the sidelines since
forever, haven't
ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even in the worst weather, you'd be there
every day with such
enthusiasm in your
eyes... Whenever I saw you, all I could
think was...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this trainer has literally nothing
better to do... Ya know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That said, I can always get a decent
reaction out of you, and we
groove
together pretty well. I've kinda grown to
like you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's just about time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welp, I'd better make use of all this
pent-up hunger! Get ready—I'm
about to
blow your mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may mess with me constantly, but as I
watch her head off toward
the track, I
can't help getting excited to see her race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, Gold Ship's big debut begins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things start off relatively well. As the race
progresses, she manages
to hold onto her
position.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They've made the last turn. It's the final
stretch! The lead is breaking
for it! Will
this decide the race?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: URAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now Gold Ship is pushing ahead with
incredible speed! She's three
lengths
behind! One length!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she pulls ahead at the finish! Gold
Ship takes the win with a
stunning debut!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What an amazing race! I'm completely
mesmerized by the way she ran!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Woohooo! Victory!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, pretty impressive, huh? The mighty
Golshi has plenty more
where that came
from!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? I'm the fastest! I'm the
brightest star! Can't help it—I
was just born
this way!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, your face is positively shining after
watching me! You've never
looked happier
than this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, that means you have no problem
staying on as my trainer, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was sort of duped into all of this, but...
the excitement I felt during
her race was
real, so...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Good! Together we shall defend the world
from evil!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's debut ends in success, and I
officially become her trainer.
I'm sure it'll
be smoother sailing from here...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: GAAARGH! I need more hunger!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How many days till my next race? Three?
Two?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Agh, if this keeps up, my burning spirit
won't last much longer! I won't
be able to
run anymore...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You know what that means—treasure
hunting time! Our adventure for
pure,
concentrated agitation begins!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Our destination awaits—the final frontier,
SPACE! HRAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a long, desperate struggle, I finally
convince Gold Ship that we
shouldn't go
to space.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's the most dynamic Umamusume I've
ever seen. I'll need to
become more
vigorous myself for whatever hurdles are
sure to come...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship and the Battle for Earth The End
